milestone: A61 by-reference Iterator current array spread through a real destructor
scope: An ordinary user Iterator with &current() returning a real global-bound ARRAY cell and a public no-argument __destruct has no owning instance fields. key() rebinds the raw current cell to a finite row with ordinary scalar reference leaves before spread dereferences and inserts it. If DATA is the last Iterator owner, the builder stays protected through __destruct, whose alias and tail writes occur before assignment and the next literal item. A retained external Iterator owner defers __destruct until after assignment. A supplied key throw with a preexisting ALIAS builder preserves its Throwable, runs the destructor, and cancels the builder. One separate Aggregate getter returns the same Iterator.

implementation.boundary: The Dtor by-reference current arm reuses the existing complete ordinary-cell and finite scalar-reference table checks. The class/current-BYREF method predicate authenticates reference-bearing builder states, including a preexisting ALIAS prefix, and survives receiver allocation retirement. Normal/abrupt release validates the protected builder from class history without dereferencing cleared CURRENT. Callback-result terminal blocking distinguishes current from key, preserving old key refusal. Existing no-Dtor and by-value Dtor routes remain disjoint; 39 ownership, 430 promotion, schema and module order are unchanged. Owning fields, special/typed/proxy/object/cyclic/debt descendants remain outside this admission.

engine_routes: vendor/php-src/Zend/zend_interfaces.c zend_user_it_get_current_data caches raw current and zend_user_it_get_current_key invokes key afterward; Zend/zend_vm_def.h ZEND_ADD_ARRAY_UNPACK dereferences/addrefs the value after key. Zend/zend_objects.c and zend_objects_API.c release the last Iterator owner and call __destruct before later literal continuation. Zend/zend_hash.c preserves shared scalar references within copied array rows.
